# Launch Checklist

> An open-source agent skill that inspects a repository and live site, then writes a project-specific launch checklist with priorities, launch blockers, verification steps and evidence.

The skill inspects without changing anything by default. It covers legal and compliance, infrastructure, security, SEO, accessibility, quality assurance, monitoring, performance, email, documentation, marketing, backups, account ownership, cost and launch-day operations, for fifteen kinds of digital product. It is not legal, security or compliance advice.

## Project

- [Home page](https://launch-checklist-skill.pages.dev/): Overview, an interactive view of the checklist library, and installation guidance.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Achal13jain/launch-checklist-skill): Source, releases and issue tracker.
- [README](https://github.com/Achal13jain/launch-checklist-skill/blob/main/README.md): Short introduction and installation commands.
- [Skill instructions](https://github.com/Achal13jain/launch-checklist-skill/blob/main/skills/launch-checklist/SKILL.md): The portable agent skill.
- [Core checklist](https://github.com/Achal13jain/launch-checklist-skill/blob/main/skills/launch-checklist/references/core-checklist.md): The items common to most launches.
- [Official sources](https://github.com/Achal13jain/launch-checklist-skill/blob/main/skills/launch-checklist/references/sources.md): The pages the skill verifies against.
- [License](https://github.com/Achal13jain/launch-checklist-skill/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT license.
